# Forge

The forge puts permanent effects on the faces of your die. Open crates with meta points to get effects, then choose a face to put one on. **Each face holds one effect**, so six faces means six choices. Cards [level up](#levels) as their face lands and when you merge copies into them. The forge opens after 5 runs (see [what opens as you play](basics.md#what-opens-as-you-play)). If you had already opened a crate, or have a card in your bag or on a face, it stays open for you.

## Crates

Every crate draws from all 48 effects. Dearer crates can't land below a certain rarity, which takes the commons (and more) out of the draw.

Every 40th crate you open is **Rare or better**, whichever crate it is.

**Opening in bulk:** tap the **OPEN x1** button on the forge page to switch between x1, x5 and x10, then pick a crate and confirm. A batch costs the crate's price times the count, and all its cards show on one reveal. x10 needs the [Crate Master](store.md#game-passes) pass, which also shows every batch's cards straight away. Each crate still rolls on its own and counts toward the guarantee, so the odds are the same as opening them one by one.

**Weekend luck:** every weekend, from Friday 20:00 UTC to Monday 04:00 UTC, every rarity above a crate's lowest gets 2 times its usual weight in the draw. The crate's lowest rarity comes up less and every rarity above it comes up more. The odds panel in the game says when it is on and shows the boosted chances. A **Double Luck Weekend** banner shows when it starts, and players who turned on Roblox notifications get one as it opens.

| Crate | Rarity | Usual chance | Weekend chance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Worn Crate | Common | 55.39% | 38.3% |
| Worn Crate | Mythic | 0.3% | 0.41% |
| Gilded Crate | Uncommon | 59.87% | 42.72% |
| Gilded Crate | Mythic | 0.67% | 0.95% |
| Astral Crate | Rare | 71.82% | 56.03% |
| Astral Crate | Mythic | 1.66% | 2.59% |

Crates can't be opened while a run is live or [saved](basics.md#save-and-quit), and the rest of the forge waits too. Finish the run, or delete the saved run with the bin on the home screen, to open them again.

## Your bag

Cards you open go into your bag. Copies of the same effect at the same level share one card with a count. Above the bag:

- **Search** by effect name or rarity.
- The **rarity** button shows every card, then only Common, Uncommon and so on up to Mythic.
- The **sort** button puts cards in the order you got them, rarest first, or A to Z.

A card from a new crate always shows, so opening one clears the search and the rarity filter.

## Loadouts

Tap **LOADOUTS** on the forge page to save what your die wears and put it back on later.

- **SAVE** stores all six faces in a slot. Saving over a used slot asks first.
- **LOAD** puts the saved effects back on. Faces that already match stay put, the rest go back to your bag, then each face takes its card from the bag. If a card is no longer in your bag, that face is left bare.
- Tap a slot's name to rename it, up to 20 characters.
- Loadouts load, and new slots can be bought, only between runs, not during one or while a run is [saved](basics.md#save-and-quit). Saving and renaming still work.

You start with 1 free slot. Each extra slot costs more meta than the last, up to 10 slots:

| Slot | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Slot 1 | Free |
| Slot 2 | 500 meta |
| Slot 3 | 1,250 meta |
| Slot 4 | 3,150 meta |
| Slot 5 | 7,800 meta |
| Slot 6 | 19,550 meta |
| Slot 7 | 48,850 meta |
| Slot 8 | 122,050 meta |
| Slot 9 | 305,200 meta |
| Slot 10 | 762,950 meta |

## Levels

Every card starts at **LV 1**. Levelling a card makes its effect stronger: each card under [Effects](#effects) shows what it does at LV 1 and how far its main number climbs by its top level. Levels never cost meta.

| Rarity | Top level |
| --- | --- |
| Common | LV 7 |
| Uncommon | LV 6 |
| Rare | LV 6 |
| Epic | LV 5 |
| Legendary | LV 5 |
| Mythic | LV 4 |

These effects have their own top level instead: Nudge (Common) at LV 2, Tithe (Uncommon) at LV 2, Magpie (Uncommon) at LV 3 and Kick (Rare) at LV 4.

**Earning XP:** a card on your die earns **10 XP** each time its face lands in a run, bonus throws included. A Mimic or Chaos face earns for its own card. When a card levels up mid run, the new level works from your next throw. Unrigged runs earn no XP, because the forge is off in them.

**Merging:** feed copies of the same effect from your bag into a card, on a face or in the bag. A fresh LV 1 copy gives **1,000 XP**. A levelled copy gives everything that went into it plus the XP it holds, so two cards of one level make one card of the next. Merging never costs meta, but the copies are used up. The cheapest copies go in first, and a card at its top level takes no more.

Putting a card on a face, taking it off and loading a [loadout](#loadouts) all keep its level and XP.

Each level needs twice the XP of the one before:

| Level up | XP needed | Landings at 10 XP | Fresh LV 1 copies | Total from LV 1 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LV 1 to 2 | 1,000 XP | 100 | 1 | 1,000 XP |
| LV 2 to 3 | 2,000 XP | 200 | 2 | 3,000 XP |
| LV 3 to 4 | 4,000 XP | 400 | 4 | 7,000 XP |
| LV 4 to 5 | 8,000 XP | 800 | 8 | 15,000 XP |
| LV 5 to 6 | 16,000 XP | 1,600 | 16 | 31,000 XP |
| LV 6 to 7 | 32,000 XP | 3,200 | 32 | 63,000 XP |

## Effects

Each card shows what its effect does at LV 1, and the line under that shows how its main number climbs from LV 1 to its top level. The numbers along the bottom of each card are the chance of getting that exact effect from one crate. Weight effects put a hidden lump inside the dice, so one side comes up more often and the side opposite it less. Only the heaviest weight on your dice counts, and each level makes a lump heavier. The table shows each weight at its top level. These chances were measured over thousands of test throws, so they are close rather than exact, and the odds panel in the game shows them for the dice you wear.

| Weight effect | Level | Side it favours | That side | The side opposite | Each other side |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Loadstone | LV 6 | Its own side | 27.2% | 8.6% | 16.1% |
| Feather | LV 7 | The side opposite it | 29.6% | 7.4% | 15.8% |
| Magnet | LV 6 | Its own side | 60.6% | 3.8% | 8.9% |

<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(92, 170, 255)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/kick.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Kick</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Rare</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">This face moves you 3 extra tiles.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 4:</b> +3 to +6</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>1.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>2.62%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>6.53%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(92, 170, 255)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/keystone.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Keystone</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Rare</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Scoring</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Roll this face and stop on a biome gate: the roll pays 3x.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 6:</b> 3x to 5x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>1.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>2.62%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>6.53%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(92, 170, 255)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/mimic.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Mimic</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Rare</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">This face copies the effect on the face you rolled last throw, at that card's level plus 0, up to its top level. It cannot copy an effect that moves you, throws more dice or weighs the die.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 6:</b> +0 to +5 levels</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>1.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>2.62%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>6.53%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(92, 170, 255)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/slingshot.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Slingshot</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Rare</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">This face moves you 1 tile, but your next roll moves twice as far and pays 2x. Bonus throws do not use it up.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 6:</b> 2x to 3x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>1.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>2.62%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>6.53%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(92, 170, 255)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/rimestone.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Rimestone</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Rare</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Scoring</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Roll this face in a frozen biome: the roll pays 3x.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 6:</b> 3x to 5x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>1.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>2.62%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>6.53%</b></span></div></div>

The count resets when you enter a new biome.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 6:</b> 2x to 3x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>1.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>2.62%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>6.53%</b></span></div></div>

The next 5 rolls pay 25% less; rolling it again restarts the 5.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 6:</b> 2.5x to 4x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>1.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>2.62%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>6.53%</b></span></div></div>

The 5th spark sets it off and that roll pays 6x, then the fuse starts again.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 5:</b> 6x to 11x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.51%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>1.14%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>2.84%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(190, 124, 255)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/duskstone.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Duskstone</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Epic</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Scoring</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Roll this face in a twilight biome: the roll pays 3.5x.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 5:</b> 3.5x to 5.9x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.51%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>1.14%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>2.84%</b></span></div></div>

### Legendary

<div class="rr-grid ">
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 102, 153)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/cardCounter.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Card Counter</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Legendary</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">For your next 2 throws, every Double Down you own is 10% more likely to hit.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 5:</b> 10% to 20%</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.38%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.95%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 102, 153)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/philosopher.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Philosopher's Stone</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Legendary</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">The tile you land on counts as golden for this roll, paying 1x your golden bonus on top. With no golden bonus yet it pays +10.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 5:</b> 1x to 2x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.38%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.95%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 102, 153)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/wildcard.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Wildcard</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Legendary</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">This face counts as whichever number suits your perks best (even or odd, high or low) and pays 2x.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 5:</b> 2x to 3x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.38%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.95%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 102, 153)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/fortuneWheel.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Wheel of Fortune</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Legendary</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Spin the wheel: the roll pays 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x or 10x. The bigger the number, the smaller its slice.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 5:</b> top slice 10x to 19x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.38%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.95%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 102, 153)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/comet.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Comet</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Legendary</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">This face moves you 8 extra tiles and every tile you pass pays double. Stops at a biome gate like any throw.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 5:</b> +8 to +16</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.38%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.95%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 102, 153)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/radiance.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Radiance</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Legendary</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Scoring</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Land on a light tile: the roll pays 6x. Any other tile: 0.8x.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 5:</b> 6x to 9x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.38%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.95%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 102, 153)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/darkness.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Darkness</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Legendary</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Scoring</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Land on a dark tile: the roll pays 6x. Any other tile: 0.8x.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 5:</b> 6x to 9x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.17%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.38%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.95%</b></span></div></div>
</div>

### Mythic

<div class="rr-grid ">
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 178, 66)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/avalanche.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Avalanche</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Mythic</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Scoring</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">This face pays 4x, on any tile.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 4:</b> 4x to 7x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.04%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.1%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.24%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 178, 66)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/resonance.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Resonance</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Mythic</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Every lucky bonus that hit this throw pays again: each Double Down hit, a won Coin Flip, Lucky Seven, and a Bloom, Glow or Turnabout an earlier throw set up. The repeat is 1x as strong, capped at 10x.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 4:</b> 1x to 1.9x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.04%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.1%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.24%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 178, 66)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/omnishot.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Omni Shot</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Mythic</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Each time this face lands, a 25% chance to throw the dice twice more, up to 4 times a roll. Those throws can trigger it again and charge no Spark. After 12 landings with no hit the next one is certain.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 4:</b> 25% to 49%</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.04%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.1%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.24%</b></span></div></div>
<div class="rr-card " style="--ring: rgb(255, 178, 66)"><div class="rr-card-head"><img class="rr-art rr-art--icon" src="../../assets/rogue-roller/icons/forge/eternity.png" alt="" loading="lazy"><div class="rr-card-title"><strong>Eternity</strong><div class="rr-tags"><span class="rr-tag">Mythic</span><span class="rr-tag rr-tag--plain">Trigger</span></div></div></div><p class="rr-card-body">Every roll this face lands is written down. When you cross a biome gate, every written roll pays again at 1x, then the list clears.</p><p class="rr-card-body"><b>LV 1 to LV 4:</b> 1x to 1.9x</p><div class="rr-card-foot"><span class="rr-price"><small>Worn</small><b>0.04%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Gilded</small><b>0.1%</b></span><span class="rr-price"><small>Astral</small><b>0.24%</b></span></div></div>

## Chaos draws

Every time a Chaos face lands, it turns into one of these 37 effects and works exactly like that effect for that throw. The level it draws at is a share of that effect's top level, rounded to a whole level, and the share climbs with Chaos's own level: 25% at LV 1, 50% at LV 2, 75% at LV 3 and the top level at LV 4. Weight effects, effects that move you (Ballista among them), Mimic and Ascensio, which only works while on your die, are never drawn.
